tagline: Haking取景器相机，1974 年发布
description: Haking于1974年推出的取景器相机。配备45mm f/2.8, stopping to f/16。快门速度1/30-1/250 +B Leaf shutter。使用36x24mm on 135 film。

specs.闪光灯: at all speeds, via PC connector or hot shoe
specs.英文简介: The Halina 3000 is a viewfinder camera for 35mm film, with a built-in meter, made by Hakings in Hong Kong - introduced c.1974.
